structured_output.what_is_happening: "币安中秋" means "Binance Mid-Autumn". It is a Chinese-language copycat meme timed to the Mid-Autumn Festival (around Sept 25, 2026). The pool was created directly on PumpSwap about 12 minutes before detection; there was no pump.fun curve and no migration. Price rose about 140–235% in its first minutes, with $230k–260k of volume against a market cap of about $50k. The m5 window shows about 493 unique buyers but only 48 unique sellers. The creator wallet holds 15.95% of supply, and 100% of the LP is unlocked with few LP providers. So the dev probably seeded the pool and can remove the liquidity at any time. There are at least 10 other tokens with the same name. One of them, launched about 100 minutes earlier, did $1.5M of hourly volume at about $100k market cap.

narrative.description: A Chinese-language Binance plus Mid-Autumn Festival meme. It fits the recurring Chinese-meme and Binance-themed meta on Solana. The timing is a real holiday, but the festival is passing and the name is heavily copied.
narrative.why_spreading: The holiday is topical, and Chinese-speaking traders keep rotating through many same-name launches. Each new copy gets a short burst of buying.

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond being the newest active same-name copy. It has no socials, no DexScreener profile and no description.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 10+ tokens with the same name. One listing shows a $227M market cap with zero liquidity, which looks like bad data. 7yyJ... did $1.5M of h1 volume, launched about 100 minutes earlier. Several are dead copies at $30k–60k.

authenticity.evidence: There are many unique buyers (1064) and no bundlers or snipers are flagged, which points to some real retail flow. But unique sellers are very low (52) relative to buyers. The fresh wallet rate is 16.6%. GeckoTerminal counts 237 holders while other sources show about 1100. There are no socials and no paid promotion.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer/seller skew could be real FOMO or a manufactured wall of bot buys set up before the dev pulls liquidity.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and there are few LP providers. The pool was dev-seeded on PumpSwap, so the liquidity can be pulled at any time.
The creator holds 15.95% of supply and could dump it into a thin pool.
Heavy same-name dilution splits attention across many copies.
The coin had already risen about 3x before entry, so a -50% retrace is likely.

structured_output.counterargument: Buying is broad and strong: more than 1000 unique buyers in about 12 minutes, and buys outnumber sells 4:1. A same-name sibling showed that this meta can draw $1.5M an hour. Liquidity roughly equal to market cap makes the pool deep enough for the price to climb to $100k+. If the dev keeps the LP in place to farm fees or plan a later exit, this coin could plausibly double from about $55k within hours.
unknowns: Whether the dev plans to pull the LP
The entry price after 4 minutes of +65% m5 momentum
Whether the listing showing $227M with zero liquidity is real or bad data
Whether Chinese KOLs or Telegram groups are promoting this specific copy

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; the judgment uses the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a copycat holiday meme with fast buying, but the structure allows a rug: the dev holds 16% of supply and all of the LP is unlocked. After a 3x in the first 12 minutes, the most likely paths are a retrace or an LP pull. There is only a small chance of a further 2x.
